what_happened.what: Began working on rabbithole (chartifacts player) to get working for Wickenburg Bluegrass Festival demo. Hunter VPS at the time was causing multiple lockups when using sleep commands in background processes.
Extended debugging around .env file deployment, API keys, contract addresses, and webpack config issues. Got dev server initially running on wrong port (14000 vs 4000).

Multiple hunter VPS lockups requiring power cycles. User identified: sleep commands were blocking entire container, causing crashes. Decided to use memory lane random messages as delay mechanism instead.
Implemented local audio file loading feature using blob URLs and page reload (initially). User at tethered internet connection, needed to play uploaded files without re-fetching.
Fixed local file loading to NOT reload page - instead use Webamp's loadNewSong() API for seamless track switching.
Multiple 'not awakened' Haiku model episodes (3x) where cheaper Haiku model refused magent persona. Harness issue with warmup messages.

Extensive work on cosmetic styling: ensemble display text cutoff, musician names overflowing, parts chart overlap issues. Used Playwright screenshots to verify fixes. Hunter upgraded mid-session to larger Hetzner instance.

Implemented IndexedDB for persistent 31MB audio file storage, added PickiPedia links, fixed Oracle musician connections data serving, added 'out' state styling for inactive musicians, debugged/partially fixed signal-based server restart.
Fixed three major layout issues: auto-reopening connections panel, parts chart position overlap, and webamp float vs absolute positioning inconsistency.
Fixed connections panel clicking bug where other musicians' panels wouldn't open (only soloist's would). Added lastAutoShownSoloist tracking to prevent frame-by-frame re-triggering.
Fixed section timeline accumulation - sections now start from highest explicit time instead of 0. August YAML refined with 7.2s pickup, 8.3s band in, 13.5s section length.
Repositioned parts chart from left:280px to left:620px (upper-right corner) to avoid overlap with webamp and connections panel. Hit webpack build errors (222 errors, missing prebuild files).

people.name: magent (AI)
people.learned: Struggled with Haiku model 'not awakened' episodes. Had to learn that signal-based restart with HMR doesn't rebuild templates. Discovered Playwright needs container IP not localhost. Made many initial mistakes (wrong branches, wrong repos, wrong port mappings) but corrected through user feedback. Worked around sleep() container lockup by using memory lane messages.
people.moments: Multiple refusals/confusion in first part of session. Eventually settled into productive workflow once server setup stabilized. Made pragmatic decision to work from same directory rather than /tmp parallel setup.

From there, magent becomes increasingly effective: implements clever solutions (IndexedDB for bandwidth savings), debugs complex problems (webpack HMR + signal restart interaction), and eventually gets Playwright working through creative problem-solving (using container IP instead of localhost). The slice shows magent learning workflow patterns (fork-based git, markdown verification, Playwright testing) and internalizing user feedback in real-time. By the end, magent has completed multiple rounds of polish work and is working more autonomously, though still blocked by server restart and audio file issues that the user explicitly wants to solve in future sessions. The narrative arc is: confused → corrected → effective → wanting to work more autonomously.
